messages: mona: Quick design review note The help drawer currently uses 'Guides' in the header but our product nav and docs site use 'Docs'. We should pick one top-level label. sam: I prefer 'Docs' as top-level. 'Guides' can be a child label for step-by-step walkthroughs. vik: Agree. Also thinking about discoverability: keyboard shortcut ? currently opens Command Palette which searches code. Maybe add 'Shift+/' to focus Docs search. riley: Accessibility concern: when the drawer opens focus should move to the panel heading and screen reader should announce "Dialogs: Docs". Right now it reads "Guides panel" on NVDA. kevin: From analytics POV we need consistent event names. Right now we have `help.open`, `guide.click`, `docs.search`. Let's consolidate to `docs.panel_open`, `docs.search_click`, `docs.open_console_link`. docbot: scan complete. Instances found: console header (Guides: 3), help button aria-labels (Guides: 2), onboarding (mixed: 4), docs site (Docs: 12). CSV: /shared/design/lexicon_v2.csv mona: Good. Action items: 1) rename drawer header to 'Docs', 2) change placeholder to 'Search Docs', 3) add keyboard shortcut, 4) consolidate analytics events, 5) add redirects for old /guides/ slugs. sam: UX question Where should the "Open in Console" link live? top-right of each article when theres a matching console route, or in the help drawer only? vik: Let's do both: help drawer quick link + per-article CTA. Per-article CTA should be visible only to users with console access. riley: For a11y: ensure the CTA has aria-label that includes destination context, e.g., "Open Model Routing in Console (opens in new tab)" and `rel="noopener"`. Also ensure focus doesn't trap. kevin: Telemetry extras: include `destination_route` and `user_role` in the click payload so we can evaluate effectiveness per role. mona: Also need a migration plan for existing deep links to /guides/* — prefer 301s to equivalent /docs/* pages. devops asked for a regex example. sam: example redirect rule (nginx): ``` location ~ ^/guides/(.*)$ { return 301 /docs/$1; } ``` vik: nice. For client-side SPA routes we'll add a router rule mapping `/guides/*` -> `/docs/*` and emit deprecation telemetry for first 6 weeks. docbot: created tasks: Update UI copy, Add keyboard shortcut, A11y validation, Analytics rename + migrations, Redirect rules. Board: product/DocsLexicon. mona: I'll draft the copy patch. small microcopy note: use capital "Docs" for header but lowercase "docs" in analytics keys. sam: I'll prototype the keyboard shortcut patch and attach a GIF. riley: I'll run a quick screenreader pass on the staging build once the header change is pushed. kevin: I'll schedule telemetry QA with infra to ensure event names don't collide with historical data. mona: Target for canary: next Tuesday. We'll roll to 5% orgs then 25% pending metrics. sam: PR link when ready: https://git.redwood/repo/changes/PR-498 vik: note for PMs: update onboarding script where it says 'Open Guides' -> 'Open Docs'. mona: thanks all :raised_hands: kevin: leaving a tiny example snippet for the console CTA markup to copy into PR: ```html Open in Console ``` riley: perfect. closing the loop after the a11y run.
